name: NullMark — Instagram/TikTok IAB escape (Apple Pay restore)
summary: NullMark smart links detect Instagram/TikTok/Facebook in-app browsers (WKWebView) and force Safari/Chrome so Payment Request API (Apple Pay / Google Pay) works. Primary cites 30–50% checkout drop when Apple Pay missing. Peer to linkboo webview escape — sharpens Never86 in-app Shop wedge (no bio→webview handoff). Watch only — not fee dogfood.
what_it_does: Smart-link redirect that escapes social IABs to the system browser in <200ms, restoring Apple Pay, cookies, and payment iframes.
how_competitors_use_it: Creators/merchants replace IG bio / Story / DM links with NullMark URLs so checkout doesn't die in Meta webviews.
what_we_use_today: Never86 in-app Shop buy-now avoids the bio→webview cliff entirely; linkboo already watched for Toast/Resy cliffs.
gap: GTM skills should name NullMark beside linkboo when bio rails are Toast/Square/Shopify/OpenTable/Resy.
never86_wedge: in-app Shop buy-now avoids bio→webview conversion cliff
not_this: Not a fee dogfood. Not forecasting. Not a Meta FBE peer.
